title: Juicy German Red Snapper Wrap
description: A savory and springy German dish featuring red snapper, shio-cure, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, wrapped in a corn husk.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure mix, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Place the red snapper fillets on a flat surface and sprinkle the shio cure mix evenly over both sides of the fillets.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fillets, making sure they are well coated.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the fillets, then sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Wrap each fillet in a corn husk, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the wrapped fillets on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove the fillets from the oven and let them rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the fillets hot, still wrapped in the corn husks.
